title: Advance Rates and Eligible Inventory, Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grades 6 to 1
content:
Under the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line, how much Kestrel advances on a unit, which units may be floored at all, how far the line may run over for in-transit factory shipments and when a factory invoice is funded are set per Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade in the two schedules below.

## Schedule 1: advance rates and limits

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Advance on a new Kestrel vehicle, percent of factory invoice | Advance on a used vehicle, percent of wholesale book value | Oldest used vehicle that may be floored (years) | Largest single-unit advance without senior credit approval (USD) | Over-line allowance for factory shipments in transit (percent) | Same-day funding cutoff (Central Time) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 100 | 80 | 6 | 90000 | 0 | 15:00 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 100 | 85 | 7 | 100000 | 0 | 15:00 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 100 | 85 | 7 | 125000 | 5 | 15:00 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 100 | 90 | 8 | 150000 | 5 | 15:00 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 100 | 90 | 8 | 200000 | 10 | 15:00 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 100 | 95 | 10 | 250000 | 10 | 15:00 |

## Schedule 2: special-use inventory

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Dealer demonstrators, maximum share of the new line (percent) | Service loaner units that may be floored (maximum count) | Rental-fleet units may be floored |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 5 | 0 | No |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 5 | 5 | No |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 8 | 10 | No |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 8 | 15 | Yes |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 10 | 25 | Yes |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 10 | 40 | Yes |

## Terms as defined for these schedules

- **New-vehicle advance rate**: advance on a new Kestrel vehicle as a percent of factory invoice.
- **Used-vehicle advance rate**: advance on a used vehicle as a percent of wholesale book value.
- **Used-vehicle age limit**: oldest used vehicle that may be floored, in years.
- **Single-unit advance limit**: largest single-unit advance without senior credit approval, in USD.
- **Over-line allowance**: percent over the line allowed for factory shipments already in transit.
- **Funding cutoff**: time (HH:MM Central Time) by which a factory invoice must be received to be funded the same business day.
- **Demonstrator limit**: share of the new line that may be dealer demonstrators.
- **Service loaner limit**: maximum service loaner units that may be floored.
- **Rental units**: whether rental-fleet units may be floored.

## Notes on the schedules

- A service loaner limit of 0 at Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 means no service loaner unit is floored on that grade.
- An over-line allowance of 0 at Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 and Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 means in-transit factory shipments receive no room beyond the line on those grades.
- Hypothetical illustration of the advance rates: a used unit with a wholesale book value of 20000 USD is advanced 80 percent of that value, 16000 USD, on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6, and 95 percent, 19000 USD, on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1. The book value is an illustrative input only.
